item.title: Reporting a broken heater in the dorm
item.context_text: It is November and you are studying in Poland. The heater in your dormitory room stopped working three days ago, and the room is very cold at night. You reported it at reception on Monday, but nothing has happened.
item.objective_text: Understand the maintenance rules, find out why nobody came, report the problem properly in writing, and follow it up by phone.
item.target_grammar: present perfect with since / for and already / yet (It hasn't worked since Monday. Nobody has come yet.)
item.cultural_note: Many housing offices only act on requests that are written down with a reference number. A spoken complaint at reception is often forgotten, so it is normal to put it in writing and politely mention the dates.
success_conditions: Understand how and when to report a repair
Find out why the first report did not work
Write a complete maintenance request with dates and the room number
Follow up by phone and ask for a temporary solution

children.title: Read the housing office notice
children.instructions: Read the notice in the corridor. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
REPAIRS IN YOUR ROOM
All repairs must be reported using the online maintenance form. Reception cannot create requests.
After you send the form, you will receive a reference number by email.
Urgent problems (no water, no heating in winter, electrical danger) are dealt with within 48 hours. Other problems: within 7 working days.
Please say when a technician can enter your room.

questions.explanation: "All repairs must be reported using the online maintenance form. Reception cannot create requests."

options: There is no heating in winter
questions.explanation: "No heating in winter" is listed as an urgent problem.

questions.prompt: What should you include in the form?
options: When a technician can come in
A photo of your student card
questions.explanation: "Please say when a technician can enter your room."

children.title: Listen to the receptionist
children.instructions: You go back to reception to ask what happened. Listen to the receptionist. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text: Oh, I'm really sorry about that. I remember you, but I'm afraid I can't send repair requests from here any more. They changed the system last month, so everything goes through the online form now. If you fill it in today and tick 'urgent', someone should come within two days. And listen, if it's really cold tonight, we have a few small electric heaters in the storage room. You can borrow one if you leave your student card with us.

questions.prompt: Why did nothing happen after your first report?
options: Reception can't send repair requests any more
questions.explanation: "I can't send repair requests from here any more. They changed the system last month."

options: Get a refund for the night
questions.explanation: "We have a few small electric heaters... You can borrow one."

children.title: Fill in the maintenance form
children.instructions: Write the description for the online form. Give your room number, describe the problem and since when, say it is urgent, and say when a technician can come in.
children.prompt_text: Maintenance request – Description of the problem:
children.goal: Write a complete, clear maintenance request.

points.label: describe the problem and since when
say when the technician can come in

children.model_answer: Room 214, Block C. The heater in my room has not worked since Monday, so for three days now. It doesn't get warm at all, and the room is very cold at night. I reported it at reception on Monday, but I have now learned that I must use this form. This is urgent because there is no heating. A technician can enter my room any time, even when I am not there.

children.title: Follow up by phone
children.instructions: Two days later, nobody has come. Call the housing office. Give your reference number, explain the situation briefly and ask what will happen next.
children.prompt_text: Housing office: Good morning, student housing. How can I help?
children.goal: Follow up politely and get a clear next step.
children.model_answer: Good morning. I'm calling about my maintenance request. The reference number is 5512. I sent the form two days ago and marked it urgent, because the heater in my room doesn't work, but nobody has come yet. Could you tell me when a technician will come, please?
